title: The algebraicity threshold for orthogonal tensor multiplicities
description: Unrefereed classification candidate: every fixed nonzero finite-dimensional algebraic O(m,C) representation has a D-finite ordinary tensor-multiplicity series, algebraic exactly when m is at most three. Scalar asymptotics are explicitly attributed to Regev and the rank-three radical to Almkvist-Dicks-Formanek. Exact finite producer diagnostics accompany the written proof. Historical priority, external specialist review, independent reproduction and formal verification are not established. Original prose is CC0-1.0; original code is MIT; third-party content is excluded or separately identified.
